rationale: The problem is a morning process with hand-offs and waits, which lean methods address directly: value stream mapping and gemba walks locate the waits, and A3 cycles test countermeasures with the people who do the work. The retrieved records place the breakdown after the screen (c1, c2), support testing coordination with respiratory therapy (c4), and show that self-extubation is rare enough to monitor as a balancing measure (c3). Weekly run charts show whether completed interruptions rise.
alternatives: Electronic reminder for the safety screen (refused: the screen is already documented on 71 percent of days and reminders changed documentation, not practice, elsewhere)
Model for Improvement with PDSA cycles (considered: similar measurement, but the unit's problem is waits and hand-offs, which value stream mapping addresses directly)
Education sessions on the protocol alone (refused: nurses know the protocol; the barriers are authority and timing)
whyNotMoreComplex: A controlled comparison with other units would not tell this unit where its own morning breaks down; weekly run charts with safety measures answer the local question.

decision.statement: Run a six-month lean A3 on the morning sedation interruption process from November 2026: map the value stream with gemba walks, then test removal of the informal approval step for patients who pass the safety screen and a shared 08:00 time with respiratory therapy, measuring completed interruptions weekly with self-extubation and agitation as balancing measures.
decision.question: How should the unit raise completed sedation interruptions?

criteria.text: The breakdown lies after the screen, where waits and hand-offs can be redesigned.

gates.requirement: Lean facilitator assigned to the unit
gates.evidence: Lean office assignment LEAN-ICU-11 for November 2026 to April 2027, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Medical and nursing sponsorship for changing the approval step
gates.evidence: Sponsor agreement of the ICU medical director and nurse manager on 2026-09-15, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Electronic reminder for the safety screen
Education sessions on the protocol alone
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c4 from retrieved records and on two investigator-supplied records for the gates; the three model leads are not cited.

summary: Lean redesign recommended; the decision rests on four ledger claims and both gates are met.
